field_evidence_note: Each index names the dossier evidence item that actually supports the canonical field; the promotion step emits one formal evidence row per field/index pair.
limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No HTTP request was sent and the regression test was not executed; the finding is static.
The advisory-cited fix a2eff05 is a commit titled as a merge but has a single parent, the v5.19.0 tag commit; no separate component commit exists for this branch.
The NVD primary metric (5.4, UI:R) and the CNA/GitHub metric (6.5, UI:N) disagree on user interaction; the dossier records the NVD primary as canonical and keeps both vectors.
Only the npm undici package is covered; bundled copies inside Node.js release lines were not checked.
The Host value is later interpolated into the request line at lib/client.js:1397-1398; that sink was read but not traced through a live client.

entry_point.description: The Request constructor in lib/core/request.js walks the caller-supplied headers object and calls processHeader(this, key, value) for each entry (lines 162, 168 and 276). Callers reach it through client.request()/dispatch, so any application that forwards an untrusted Host value into undici headers reaches the unvalidated branch.

trace.description: Host key is recognized and the raw value is stored
Stored host is interpolated verbatim into the HTTP request line

location.verification_method: Static read of lib/core/request.js and lib/client.js at v5.19.0 and v5.19.1, plus the fix diff. No code executed.

open_questions: Whether every public API path (fetch, request, stream, pipeline) funnels the Host value through this same processHeader branch was not exhaustively traced.
Whether Node.js bundled undici versions were patched by the corresponding Node security releases was not checked.
prepared_by: Codex collecting agent (single reviewer); no independent reviewer assigned

required_before_promotion: An independent reviewer must read lib/core/request.js at v5.19.0 and confirm the Host branch bypasses headerCharRegex.
An independent reviewer must confirm a2eff05 is in v5.19.1 and not in v5.19.0.
No formal reviews.jsonl row may be written until a named independent reviewer returns a verdict.

source_crosscheck.notes: CVE v5 (assigner GitHub_M) supplies CVSS 3.1 6.5 (UI:N) and CWE-93. NVD has a genuine primary assessment of its own: CVSS 3.1 5.4 MEDIUM with UI:R and CWE-74, alongside the GitHub secondary metric 6.5 and CWE-93. This is a real source disagreement, not a mirror: the canonical severity uses the NVD primary 5.4/UI:R and the CNA vector is kept in the severity fields only as an alternate; cwe_ids keep both CWE-93 (CNA) and CWE-74 (NVD primary). OSV metadata lists both CWEs and the same 2.0.0<5.19.1 range, and carries a third vector variant (PR:L/UI:R) without a numeric score; it is recorded here and not used for the canonical severity.

fixed_releases.verified_content: At the v5.19.1 commit, processHeader rejects a Host value when headerCharRegex matches, throwing InvalidArgumentError before request.host is assigned; v5.19.0 has no such check in that branch.

severity.numeric_level_rationale: NVD primary CVSS 3.1 numeric 5.4 falls in Medium (4.0-6.9). The CNA/GitHub secondary metric is 6.5 (UI:N) and is recorded as an alternate, not merged.
